Court Orders FIR Against Actress, Husband, and Police Officer

A Kochi court has directed the registration of a First Information Report (FIR) against actress Lakshmipriya, her husband, and a woman police sub-inspector. The complaint was filed by actor Ansiba Hassan, who alleges that Lakshmipriya filed a false complaint against her. Hassan also accuses the police sub-inspector of harassment and unlawful detention during the verification of these allegations.
